_about: KNW-08 R2/R4 (decision 2026-10-06): Quranpedia per-verse Hafs recitations for Quran listening, played verse by verse with the recited verse highlighted. Hafs only (Rafeeq's mushaf text is Hafs). Each reciter is a review-desk item `recitation` and is shown to learners only after the Sharia reviewer has listened to a sample of its surahs and approved it; al-Muaiqly (IslamHouse, per surah) stays until then. Names and riwaya checked against api.quranpedia.net/v1/reciters on 2026-10-06.
license: Quranpedia API terms: free in live apps, credit optional. The recordings belong to the reciters: written confirmation pending (Musallam, product owner) before public launch.
